title: Expected maximum restricted decision tree depth
statement: Let $m,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $f_0,\ldots,f_{m-1}$ be Boolean functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $\delta\in[0,1]$. Suppose that for every function in the family and every nonnegative integer $k$, the probability under a random restriction with parameter $\delta$ that its restricted decision tree has depth at least $k$ is at most $(1/4)^k$. Then the expected maximum restricted decision tree depth of the family is at most $\lceil\log_2(m+1)\rceil+2$.
